'''Spearhead''' was an ancient [[fortress]] [[city]] on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]], home of the rogue [[Gungan]] [[warlord]] [[Boss]] [[Rogoe]]. During a [[Gungan tribal war|war]] between the Gungan tribes [[Millennium|millennia]] before the [[Imperial Era]], Spearhead became host to the remaining holdouts against Boss [[Gallo]], a Gungan who sought to unite the tribes. Gallo's [[Gallo's army|army]] [[Destruction of Spearhead|destroyed]] Spearhead, and a new Gungan [[capital]] called [[Otoh Gunga]] was built atop its ruins, with Gallo's initial foundations becoming known as the [[Ancient Quarter]].<ref name="Nexus" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spearhead was first mentioned in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', a [[2016]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]] sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Nexus" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Spearhead/Legends|Spearhead]] was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> released on [[November 7]], [[2001]],<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> released on [[November 11]] the same year.<ref name="GBDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.gamespot.com/games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds|archivedate=20201203224932}}</ref>
